description: The ANSI EXTRACT(<part> FROM <expr>) syntax is accepted - desugared to the two-argument EXTRACT('<part>', <expr>) form - in addition to the comma form, over both DATE and TIMESTAMP values and inside a larger expression. Previously only the comma form parsed. Converted 1:1 from functions/ExtractFromSyntaxTest (now retired).

steps.sql: SELECT EXTRACT(month FROM '2023-05-08'::DATE), EXTRACT(year FROM '2023-05-08'::DATE), EXTRACT(day FROM '2023-05-08'::DATE)
